learningObjective: Distinguish the semantics of AllReduce and AllGather as collective operations over a device group.
stem: N ranks each hold a tensor T_i of identical shape S. After the collective, each rank must observe a specific result. Which statement correctly distinguishes AllReduce (sum) from AllGather along a new leading axis?

options.text: After AllReduce and after AllGather, every rank holds a tensor of shape [N, *S]; AllReduce differs only in that it also multiplies each slice by 1/N so that a subsequent local sum yields the reduction.
After AllReduce (sum), every rank holds a tensor of shape S equal to Σ_i T_i; after AllGather, every rank holds a tensor of shape [N, *S] containing all T_i stacked.
After AllReduce (sum), every rank holds a tensor of shape [N, *S] equal to the concatenation of the T_i; after AllGather, every rank holds only its own T_i annotated with the ranks of the peers.

AllReduce and AllGather are semantically identical; the difference is purely an implementation choice — AllGather is a synonym used by MPI while AllReduce is the corresponding NCCL name for the same operation.

explanation: AllReduce combines per-rank inputs via an associative reduction, producing a tensor of the same shape S on every rank whose value is the reduction (here Σ_i T_i). AllGather is pure data movement: every rank ends with a tensor containing all N inputs (typically shape [N, *S] when stacking on a new axis, or [N·d, *rest] when concatenating along an existing one).

optionExplanations.A: Wrong: AllReduce output has shape S, not [N, *S], and it does not silently scale by 1/N.
optionExplanations.B: Correct: matches the standard collective-communication semantics for AllReduce and AllGather.
optionExplanations.D: Wrong: MPI and NCCL both define AllReduce and AllGather as distinct primitives with different semantics.

assumptions: All ranks participate with tensors of the same shape and dtype.
The reduction operator for AllReduce is the standard element-wise sum.
nonImplications: Does not imply that ring-AllReduce internally materializes the gathered tensor on any rank.
Does not imply that AllReduce with mean is unavailable; it is standard in DL frameworks.

distractorRationales.A: Confuses shape and adds a spurious 1/N scaling.
